description.value: Free Bird Table & Bar is a Southern-inspired restaurant in Richmond, BC, serving comfort food classics like fried chicken and traditional Southern dishes in a warm, rustic atmosphere. Located within the Executive Hotel Vancouver Airport complex on Alderbridge Way, it offers a full sit-down dining experience with event hosting capacity for up to 800 guests. The brand also operates a second location in Squamish, making it a recognizable culinary name for cyclists riding the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the restaurant's address (5991 Alderbridge Way, Richmond, BC) and phone number ((604) 279-5598), both matching OSM tags. The site's navigation includes an 'Order Online' link, providing positive evidence for takeout. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all three required criteria remain null.
concerns: Restaurant is located within or associated with the Executive Hotel Vancouver Airport complex — may be primarily oriented toward hotel guests and convention delegates rather than passing cyclists.

OSM opening_hours tag (07:00-22:00) is broadly consistent with website contact page ('Open daily from 7am until 10pm') but other website pages show 'Open Daily 3pm-10pm' for Richmond, suggesting some internal inconsistency in the website copy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active restaurant with confirmed contact details and online ordering, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence; on-site verification is needed before listing.

wow_evidence: also operates a second location in Squamish
